team.summary: Rupal Patel is a speech scientist and professor with deep research expertise in speech motor control and assistive communication, but lacks prior startup exit experience. The team appears to be a solo founder with academic rather than commercial background.

founders.name: Rupal Patel

team.technicalDepth: High technical depth in speech science and assistive communication technology, but unclear if the core model/integration layer is owned in-house or relies on external platforms.

product.plainLanguage: Voice prostheses for people who cannot speak in their own voices.
